newsitem.title: USA: Suiza completes Dairy Fresh acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Suiza completes Dairy Fresh acquisition.

text.p: Suiza Foods Corp said Wednesday it has completed its acquisition of privately held Dairy Fresh L.P., a Winston-Salem, N.C.,-based milk and ice-cream processor.
Gregg Engles, Suiza's chairman and chief executive officer, said Dairy Fresh was its eighth dairy acquisition since Suiza entered dairy processing and distribution in 1993.
Dairy Fresh's annual sales of $125 million will increase Suiza's fluid dairy sales to "well over the $700 million level," he said.
